name: Momentum Breakout
description: High relative volume stocks near 52-week highs with bullish technical breakouts
screening_prompt: Find Canadian stocks (TSX, TSX-V listed) with high relative volume (>2x average), trading near 52-week highs, with bullish technical breakout patterns. Focus on mid-to-large cap Canadian companies with strong earnings growth. Only include stocks trading on Canadian exchanges.
trading_style: Day to swing trader, 2-5 day holds

name: Value Accumulation
description: Undervalued names with insider buying and strong fundamentals
screening_prompt: Find undervalued Canadian stocks (TSX, TSX-V listed) with P/E below sector average, recent insider buying, growing free cash flow, and strong balance sheets. Only include stocks trading on Canadian exchanges.

name: Mean Reversion
description: Oversold stocks near support levels primed for a bounce
screening_prompt: Find Canadian stocks (TSX, TSX-V listed) with RSI below 30, trading near established support levels, with positive divergences forming. Only include stocks trading on Canadian exchanges.
ta_focus: Divergences, oversold bounces, and support tests

name: Earnings Play
description: Stocks reporting earnings within 2 weeks with high implied volatility
screening_prompt: Find Canadian stocks (TSX, TSX-V listed) reporting earnings within the next 2 weeks that have high implied volatility, strong historical earnings beats, and analyst estimate revisions trending upward. Only include stocks trading on Canadian exchanges.

name: Crypto Swing
description: Swing trade crypto assets with strong momentum and on-chain metrics
screening_prompt: Find cryptocurrencies with strong price momentum, increasing on-chain activity (active addresses, transaction volume, TVL growth), positive funding rates, and strong social sentiment. Focus on top 100 by market cap.
ta_focus: Trend strength and momentum continuation patterns

name: Crypto Intraday Scalp
description: Short-term crypto scalps on 15-minute charts with tight risk management
screening_prompt: Find cryptocurrencies with high 24-hour volume, strong short-term momentum, clear intraday trends on 15-minute candles, and tight spreads. Focus on top 50 by market cap with active trading pairs on major exchanges.
ta_focus: VWAP holds, intraday momentum, and micro support/resistance in crypto
trading_style: Crypto intraday scalper, 15 min to 2 hour holds

name: Intraday Scalp
description: Short-term momentum scalps on 15-minute charts with tight risk management
screening_prompt: Find Canadian stocks (TSX, TSX-V listed) with high intraday volume, tight spreads, and strong short-term momentum. Focus on liquid Canadian names with clear intraday trends, VWAP holds, and volume spikes on 15-minute candles. Only include stocks trading on Canadian exchanges.
ta_focus: VWAP holds, intraday momentum, and micro support/resistance
trading_style: Intraday scalper, 15 min to 2 hour holds
